description: The anthology opens with stories of alien intelligence, artificial life, genetic experimentation, virtual reality and human ambition, repeatedly turning promising technologies or encounters into tests of character and survival.

s01e01-02.description: Scientist Simon Kress secretly keeps intelligent Martian creatures after his project is shut down, only to lose control as their colony grows, adapts and begins responding to its creator.

s01e03.description: A disabled man tests an android companion named Valerie, whose programmed attachment becomes dangerously possessive when he grows close to his physical therapist.

s01e04.description: Two brothers battle over a medical breakthrough that may grant extraordinary longevity, and greed turns the discovery into a contest over who deserves to control it.

s01e05.description: Humanity's first formal contact with the N'Tal offers apparent cooperation, but a skeptical doctor begins to suspect the visitors' life-saving arrangement conceals a deeper cost.

s01e06.description: An elderly tycoon clings desperately to life through constant medical intervention, forcing those around him to confront what his fear of death is costing everyone else.

s01e07.description: A lonely girl with dangerous psychic abilities meets a nanny who shares similar powers, leaving her parents to decide whether protecting her means suppressing or accepting what she is.

s01e08.description: A scientist develops technology capable of viewing possible futures and becomes trapped in a billionaire's political ambitions, where changing what lies ahead may be his only escape.

s01e09.description: After an experimental brain implant saves his life, a man begins experiencing violent images that seem to belong to someone else and must discover what the device has connected him to.

s01e10.description: A disillusioned priest receives miraculous healing powers from apparent aliens, then learns that their benevolence may be part of a plan with catastrophic consequences for humanity.

s01e11.description: When a child disappears, his sister insists that something beneath the bed took him, drawing investigators toward a possibility the adults are reluctant to accept.

s01e12.description: A transport ship is knocked out of hyperspace by mysterious dark matter, forcing its pilot to confront both the threat outside the vessel and unresolved choices from his past.

s01e13.description: A selfish ex-con encounters visitors who alter his capacity for empathy, transforming his outlook while raising questions about whether compassion can be imposed from outside.

s01e14.description: A human soldier captured during an alien war shares a cell with a cadet undergoing a horrifying transformation, forcing him to reconsider both his enemy and the war itself.

s01e15.description: A college student is overtaken by an alien force that drives compulsive intimacy and absorbs the people she touches, while friends struggle to understand what is happening to her.

s01e16.description: An astronaut returning from Mars discovers an alien presence aboard his spacecraft and faces an impossible choice to prevent it from reaching Earth.

s01e17.description: A radical medical technology intended to heal the body is used without proper restraint, and its accelerating changes turn a miracle into a lethal experiment.

s01e18.description: A deaf woman receives an experimental hearing device and begins receiving what appear to be desperate alien transmissions, making her the only person able to hear a distant plea for help.

s01e19.description: A sophisticated robot is accused of killing its creator, and a legal battle over motive and responsibility asks whether an artificial being can possess conscience as well as intelligence.

s01e20.description: A skeptical physicist investigates a house believed to be haunted and discovers that the building's strange behaviour may have a cause far outside conventional science.

s01e21.description: After a freak accident, an environmentally minded senator learns that his own identity is not what he believed and that his hidden purpose may threaten the planet he has tried to protect.

s01e22.description: A civilian tries to convince a military committee that seemingly separate alien incidents form evidence of a coordinated threat, while officials question whether his conclusions are reason or paranoia.
